# Served as a static file rather than generated by app/robots.ts: the
# top-level [product] dynamic segment matched /robots.txt first and answered
# 404, so the generated version never reached crawlers. A file in public/ is
# resolved before route matching, so it cannot be shadowed.
# Keep the Sitemap line in step with SITE.domain in src/lib/site.ts.

Disallow: /admin
